File Dock

Codex / DSH-style right-click file actions & local browser for Google Antigravity on Windows

English | 简体中文

--- ## Why File Dock? In **Google Antigravity 2.0**, right-clicking native `file://` chips inside chat messages only shows `Copy`, without direct Windows local actions like **Open File**, **Open in Side Pane**, **Open in VS Code**, **Open with...**, **Save as...**, or **Reveal in File Explorer**. Because Antigravity plugins run in isolated MCP App iframes rather than patching the closed Electron shell, **File Dock** (`file-dock`) brings the full Codex / DSH experience cleanly via standard **MCP + MCP Apps (SEP-1865)**: - **Zero external dependencies**: Pure Node.js (`>=18`) stdio MCP server + self-contained single-file HTML UIs. - **Does not touch Antigravity installation files**: Lives solely in `~/.gemini/config/plugins/file-dock/`. - **Bilingual UI (`EN` / `中`)** with automatic locale detection and light/dark host theme sync. --- ## Previews ### Inline Chat File Card (with Right-Click Context Menu)

### Side-Pane & Global File Browser

--- ## Right-Click Menu Actions Right-clicking any row (or clicking `⋯`) opens the floating menu: | Action | Implementation | | --- | --- | | **Open File / Folder** | Opens with the Windows default application (`Start-Process -LiteralPath`) | | **Open in Side Pane** | Opens inside Antigravity's built-in side-pane `fileView` (`com.google.antigravity/toggle-aux-pane`) | | **Open in VS Code** | Launches VS Code (`Code.exe` / `code.cmd` detected from standard paths or `PATH`) | | **Open with ›** | Pops up the native Windows application chooser (`rundll32 shell32.dll,OpenAs_RunDLL`) | | **Save as...** | Opens a native Windows `SaveFileDialog` and copies the file safely | | **Copy Path** | Copies the full Windows path (with server-side `Clipboard.SetText` fallback) | | **Copy File Content** | Reads UTF-8 text files (up to 1 MiB, binary-guarded) into the clipboard | | **Reveal in File Explorer** | Opens Windows Explorer and highlights the file (`explorer.exe /select,`) | Double-clicking a file row reveals it directly in Windows File Explorer. --- ## Installation (Windows) ### Prerequisites - Windows 10 / 11 - Node.js `>=18` on `PATH` ### Clone into Antigravity's plugin directory Using PowerShell: ```powershell git clone https://github.com/Su-1003/file-dock.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\file-dock" ``` Antigravity automatically discovers plugins in `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\`. No manual registration or restart is needed (or toggle it from the Customizations page). --- ## Usage 1. **Automatic Inline Cards**: With the bundled `rules/AGENTS.md` active, Antigravity automatically attaches a File Dock card (`show_files_inline`) after generating final deliverables. 2. **On-Demand**: Ask `"Show current workspace files in File Dock"` in chat. 3. **Side-Pane / Global Browser**: Click **`+`** in the right auxiliary pane → **File Dock 文件坞**, or open it from the left sidebar to browse local drives, pinned folders, and recent `~/.gemini/antigravity/brain` outputs. --- ## Project Structure ```text file-dock/ ├── plugin.json # Plugin manifest ├── mcp_config.json # MCP server registration (node server/index.mjs) ├── server/index.mjs # Zero-dependency Windows MCP Server (tools + resources) ├── dist/ │ ├── inline.html # Self-contained inline chat card UI │ └── app.html # Self-contained side-pane & global browser UI ├── rules/AGENTS.md # Always-on rule to surface deliverable cards ├── assets/logo.png # App icon └── tests/verify.mjs # Unit & stdio JSON-RPC integration tests ``` --- ## Verification ```powershell node tests/verify.mjs ``` --- ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
